key_insights: Bitcoin stuck below $20K resistance for 4+ months of consolidation (June-October), compressing volatility to historically low levels
Volatility compression typically precedes sharp moves - analog to 2018 where long consolidation led to 50% breakdown from $6K to $3K
Cred warns not to fade volatility expansion too early as strategy shift could lead to being carried out on wrong side of large moves
Bullish scenario: Continued bearish retests of $20K-$21K that don't follow through (similar to post-COVID recovery at $5-7K)
Cred's approach: Let breakdowns happen to reach cyclical support levels ($14K, $12K) OR wait for failed breakdown/reclaim before entering

trading_ideas.entry: Breakdown to cyclical levels $14K or $12K OR reclaim of $20K-$21K with weekly close above
trading_ideas.stop: Below support if buying at cyclical levels
trading_ideas.speaker: Cred

summary: Cred analyzes Bitcoin's 4-month consolidation below $20K resistance, noting historically low volatility that typically precedes sharp moves. He's bearish given $20K acts as resistance rather than support, with 6th test of $18-19K support. Cred warns against fading volatility expansion early, suggesting letting breakdowns reach cyclical levels ($14K, $12K) or waiting for failed breakdowns. Potential bullish setup involves continued bearish retests of $20K that don't follow through. Ethereum stuck below $1400 resistance. Traditional indices (S&P, NASDAQ) also showing bearish structure with broken support.
